templates.why_chosen: Star, high-confidence matrix exemplar with a genuine 2-by-3 grid, two cases against three rounds, tracing coloured numbered arrows through identically laid-out cells, with a legend below defining buffer-segment and arrow colours.
templates.what_to_learn: Build the grid so every cell keeps the identical buffer sketch and only the highlighted arrow colour and an enable/disable label change between cells, and put the one legend below the whole grid rather than repeating it per cell; six dense cells plus a separate schematic is already a lot, so keep individual cells sparse.

templates.why_chosen: Star-rated round-by-round grid: Round 1-3 columns cross Case 1/Case 2 lanes, each cell showing the same four colored buffer segments so xbar-routed element-wise ops (Case 1) visibly contrast with DMA-buffered reduction ops (Case 2).
templates.what_to_learn: When two execution modes need comparing across the same repeating rounds, draw a small Round-by-Round-times-Case grid instead of one long timeline, keep the same colored segments in every cell so the eye tracks what changes, and reuse one arrow color per data item (Block-1/2/3) to trace it across rounds.
